cpp.source: int grouped(int a) { int first = a, second = first + 1; return second; }
int readonly(int a) { const int value = a; value = 2; return value; }
int missing(int a) { int value = MissingValue; return value; }
short implicit(int a) { short value = a; return value; }
int own(int value) { { int value = value; return value; } }

rust.source: fn shadow(value: i32) -> i32 { let value: i32 = value + 1; let value: i32 = value + 2; value }
fn readonly(a: i32) -> i32 { let value: i32 = a; value = 2; value }
fn missing(a: i32) -> i32 { let value: i32 = MissingValue; value }
fn implicit(a: i32) -> i8 { let value: i8 = a; value }
fn discarded(a: i32) -> i32 { let value: i32 = a; value; }
